why_ai: Vehicles are sold, delivered and repaired on site by licensed dealers whose franchise is protected by state law, while ordering and F&I paperwork are screen work.
why_clarity: Units sold, gross, repair orders and claims are measured exactly, but ordering, desking and service selling rest on judgement whose outcome arrives weeks later.
why_digital: Starts from physical vehicles and in-store customers and ends with a car handed over or repaired locally, with research and paperwork increasingly online.

why_ai: Cars are inspected and repaired in the bay by technicians, and customers trust a known advisor; booking and follow-up are the automatable edges.
why_clarity: Repair orders, hours and gross are counted exactly, but what to recommend and how to sell it varies by advisor.
why_digital: The work starts and ends with a physical vehicle at the store, with scheduling and approvals moving to phone and text.

why_ai: Answering and booking service calls is routine conversation against a scheduler, the kind of work voice agents now do.
why_clarity: A booked, kept appointment is an exact outcome repeated thousands of times a month and known within days.
why_digital: Calls, texts and scheduler entries are digital end to end, though the appointment leads to a physical visit.

why_ai: The finding comes from a technician's physical inspection and the approval from the customer's trust in the advisor's recommendation.
why_clarity: Approved hours per repair order are measured on every visit, but how to present a finding is learned by feel.
why_digital: Inspection photos and text approvals are digital, but the input is a car on a lift and the result is a physical repair.

why_ai: Ordering is screen work, but reading a local market against an allocation formula and incentives is a consequential judgement with slow feedback.
why_clarity: Days-to-turn and gross are exact outcomes, but each manager orders differently and results arrive weeks later, confounded by price moves.
why_digital: Allocation offers, orders, sales history and registration data are all data; the product is units on a physical lot.

why_ai: Coding repair orders into claims against a policy manual is rule-bound document work that software can check and draft.
why_clarity: Each claim is paid, rejected or charged back against written OEM rules, across thousands of near-identical cases.
why_digital: Repair orders, technician stories and claims are digital, with returned parts and photos as the physical remainder.

why_ai: Dealership sales turn on relationships, OEM approval and lawyers' and advisors' judgement in rare, high-stakes negotiations.
why_clarity: Each deal is bespoke; closing is clear but whether the price was right is known years later.
why_digital: Diligence is documents and financials, but negotiation and OEM approval run through meetings and relationships.

why_ai: Technicians diagnose and repair vehicles by hand in the bay, with OEM certifications behind warranty work.
why_clarity: Labour guides define the job and a fixed or comeback car is a fast, objective check.
why_digital: The input is a physical vehicle and the output is a repaired one, delivered at the store.

why_ai: Repeat business customers buy from a commercial manager they trust, and upfitting is physical work by outside body builders.
why_clarity: On-time delivery of a correctly configured truck is measurable, but every body configuration and upfitter differs.
why_digital: Quotes and orders are digital, but upfit and delivery are physical and relationships are local.

why_ai: Matching deals to programme rules and reconciling payments is mechanical back-office work.
why_clarity: Programme rules are written and each claim is paid or charged back, monthly, at volume.
why_digital: Bulletins, deal records, claims and statements are all digital.

why_ai: Document checks against state rules are automatable, but a compliance officer and the business manager carry accountability for the sale.
why_clarity: Required documents and disclosures are written into statute and checked on every deal, though defects surface later in audits.
why_digital: Deal jackets are e-signed or scanned documents reviewed on screen.

why_ai: Survey fielding and analysis are automatable; brand reputation and award licensing give some protection.
why_clarity: Annual studies follow a fixed method, but whether a ranking drives better service is slow and indirect to check.
why_digital: Online surveys in, reports and award licences out.

why_ai: Aggregating DMS transaction feeds into benchmarks and forecasts is data engineering and statistics that AI accelerates.
why_clarity: Daily feeds and weekly reports recur and forecasts are graded by reported sales.
why_digital: DMS feeds in, data products out, sold remotely.

why_ai: Internal reporting and acquisition screens are automatable; deal judgement and accountability to executives remain.
why_clarity: Store benchmarks recur monthly; acquisition outcomes take years.
why_digital: DMS data in, internal dashboards and models out.

why_ai: Turning programme bulletins into structured feeds is extraction work AI does well.
why_clarity: Each programme has written terms and an effective date, and a wrong load is caught quickly in quotes.
why_digital: Bulletins in, data feeds and APIs out.

why_ai: Network studies and expert reports carry consequential, contested judgement and a named expert's credibility in disputes.
why_clarity: Methods are documented but contested by the other side, and whether a network plan was right is known years later.
why_digital: Sales and registration data in, studies out, with testimony and OEM meetings in person.

why_ai: Composites are automatable; members pay for the facilitated peer relationship and meetings.
why_clarity: Monthly composites follow a standard statement, but the value of facilitation is a matter of members' judgement.
why_digital: Financial statements in, composites out, with in-person meetings central to the product.

why_ai: Call grading and scoring is exactly what speech and language models now automate.
why_clarity: Each call is graded against a defined rubric at enormous volume, and appointments set are checkable.
why_digital: Recorded calls in, scorecards and alerts out.

why_ai: Survey administration and scoring automate; OEM relationships and programme design give some protection.
why_clarity: Every dealer is scored monthly on a defined survey, though what drives scores is debated.
why_digital: Online surveys in, dealer scorecards out.

why_ai: Matching recalls to owners and sending outreach is routine data and messaging work.
why_clarity: Owners contacted and appointments booked are counted exactly at volume.
why_digital: Registration and recall data in, messages and bookings out.

why_ai: Computing rates from repair orders automates, but statutory argument with OEMs and association endorsements protect the firms.
why_clarity: Statutes define the calculation and the OEM approves or contests within set windows.
why_digital: Repair-order data in, submissions out, all remote.

why_ai: An auditor must physically walk the lot and scan each financed vehicle.
why_clarity: Each unit is present, sold or missing, checked the same way on every visit.
why_digital: The input is vehicles on a lot; the report ships digitally to the lender.

why_ai: Licensed CPAs sign audits and returns and carry the liability; preparation work automates.
why_clarity: Accounting standards and tax rules codify the work, which recurs on fixed deadlines.
why_digital: Books in, statements and returns out, with local relationships driving who is hired.

why_ai: Statutory adjudicators must decide franchise disputes personally, under law that will not delegate to software.
why_clarity: Statutes frame decisions, but each dispute is contested and outcomes are slow.
why_digital: Filings are documents, but hearings and licensing are jurisdiction-bound and in person.

why_ai: A named expert's credibility under cross-examination is the product, in adversarial, high-stakes cases.
why_clarity: Each case is bespoke and the verdict, not a check, decides whether the analysis was right.
why_digital: Data and reports are digital; testimony is in person and experts are hired by reputation.

why_ai: Investigators and government attorneys act under statutory authority on contested cases.
why_clarity: Rules are written but each case is fact-specific and resolved slowly.
why_digital: Complaints and deal files are documents; enforcement is jurisdiction-bound.

why_ai: In-person shops need a human posing as a customer at the store, though phone and online shops automate.
why_clarity: Shops follow a scripted checklist scored the same way each time.
why_digital: Store visits and calls in, scored reports out.
